architecture: 75% L1 LightGBM residual margin + 25% L2 LightGBM residual margin; L2 residual component shrunk to 75% toward market. Separate logistic calibrators for moneyline and cover probabilities.
validation_note: All 2021-2025 walk-forward predictions informed final V2.5 development and calibration. They are development evidence, not a new untouched holdout. The 2026 forward test is the clean validation.
live_feature_note: V2.5 intentionally uses the same live-generatable feature families as the existing V2.2/V2.3 pipeline: market/context, PBP team/matchup/possession, QB weekly, ESPN QBR, NGS, snaps, depth and injury counts. It does not depend on the sparse PFR/FTN families that were not in the V2.2 deployment feature list.
probability_note: Moneyline and spread probabilities are calibrated from historical walk-forward predictions. Odds/EV are estimates, not guarantees.
